newsitem.title: CHINA: GUJING FIRST-HALF NET 140.14 MLN YUAN.
newsitem.headline: GUJING FIRST-HALF NET 140.14 MLN YUAN.

text.p: China's Anhui Gujing Distillery Co Ltd notched up net profits of 140.14 million yuan in the first half of 1997, the Shenzhen Stock Exchnnge said on Monday.
The company's per-share net reached 0.60 yuan, with net assets per share valued at 3.83 yuan at the end of June, the exchange said in a notice issued after the market closed.
The exchange did not give any comparative figures or clarify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards.
The company posted unaudited net profits of 134 million yuan for the first half of 1996 based on Chinese accounting standards.
Trading in the company's A shares and B shares would be suspended on Tuesday morning and would resume in the afternoon, the exchange said.
